svg.text: Hub and spoke (A) + folded avatar/name symmetry (D) + the two non-interface sections moved out (F).
A mock, not a screenshot — nothing in the app has changed.
Reaching the bottom is eight flings.
Two of these nine sections are inert
Six rows · every one a live summary
Response hint and the group-chats switch
move out — neither is an interface setting.
One editor, a side selector — not two cards
Synced, so both sides move together.
Drag here, or on the preview
Sliders, corners, fit and side collapse from
The floating buttons come home here
Everything that decides the shape of a turn,
in one place you can see at once.
Drawn by docs/mocks/gen_interface_mock.py · palette is the app's own M3 light scheme from seed #7C5CFF.
